content.value_statement: Multi-agent systems often lose time and budget through unclear handoffs and unmeasured bottlenecks. This skill guides profiling, workload distribution, and cost-aware orchestration improvements.
actual_capabilities: Establishes baseline metrics and target performance goals for multi-agent systems.
Profiles agent workloads to identify coordination bottlenecks and latency sources.
Suggests workload distribution patterns for parallel and fault-tolerant execution.
Applies cost controls through token budgets, caching, and model selection guidance.
Recommends validation steps, rollout controls, and rollback planning for changes.
limitations: Requires measurable performance data or a clear evaluation plan.
Does not replace environment-specific load testing or production monitoring.
Focuses on multi-agent orchestration, not single prompt tuning.
Provides planning guidance and examples, not a complete orchestration runtime.

use_cases.title: Improve Agent Pipeline Throughput
use_cases.description: Profile slow agent handoffs and redesign work distribution for faster completion.

use_cases.title: Control LLM Operating Costs
use_cases.description: Set token budgets, caching rules, and model selection policies for recurring workflows.

use_cases.title: Plan Safer Orchestration Changes
use_cases.description: Define validation metrics, staged rollout steps, and rollback criteria before deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Baseline a Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner starting point for a known workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to baseline my multi-agent workflow. Target: [system]. Goals: [latency, throughput, cost, or quality]. Available metrics: [data].

prompt_templates.title: Find Coordination Bottlenecks
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate diagnosis after basic metrics exist.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this agent workflow for coordination bottlenecks. Include workload distribution, blocking steps, context usage, and validation metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Design Cost Controls
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced optimization for recurring LLM workloads.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a cost optimization plan for this multi-agent system. Include token budgets, caching opportunities, model selection rules, and quality guardrails.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Optimization Roadmap
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning across performance, cost, and reliability.
prompt_templates.prompt: Produce a phased optimization roadmap for this multi-agent platform. Include baseline metrics, experiments, rollout gates, risk controls, and rollback triggers.

output_examples.input: A support triage workflow has slow handoffs between classification, retrieval, and response agents.
output_examples.output: A bottleneck report identifying slow handoffs, proposed parallel retrieval, caching options, and metrics for comparing response time and answer quality.

output_examples.input: An engineering team wants to reduce monthly LLM spend without hurting review quality.
output_examples.output: A cost plan with token budgets, model routing criteria, reuse opportunities, and quality thresholds for staged evaluation.

output_examples.input: A platform team plans to deploy a new multi-agent orchestration strategy.
output_examples.output: A rollout checklist covering baseline measurement, regression tests, canary scope, monitoring signals, and rollback criteria.

best_practices: Measure baseline latency, throughput, cost, and quality before changing orchestration.
Apply changes incrementally and compare each result against a stable benchmark.
Pair cost reductions with quality thresholds to avoid hidden regressions.
anti_patterns: Optimizing agent coordination without measurable goals or repeatable tests.
Changing model routing or caching rules without monitoring output quality.
Deploying orchestration changes across every workflow at the same time.

faq.question: What does this skill optimize?
faq.answer: It optimizes multi-agent workflow coordination, latency, throughput, cost, and validation planning.

faq.question: Does it run performance tests automatically?
faq.answer: No. It helps design profiling, metrics, and validation steps that teams can run in their environment.

faq.question: Can it help reduce LLM costs?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides token budgets, caching, result reuse, and model selection policies.

faq.question: Is it useful for single-agent prompt tuning?
faq.answer: No. The skill is designed for workflows that use multiple coordinated agents.

faq.question: What inputs work best?
faq.answer: Provide the target system, goals, current metrics, constraints, and quality thresholds.

faq.question: Does it replace expert review?
faq.answer: No. Teams should validate recommendations with environment-specific tests and operational review.
